correctness.rationale: The base-five Frobenius factorization gives the constant term as the digit product modulo five: reduce a zero exponent sum modulo five, where its lowest exponent contribution is in [-4,4], and iterate. T_0 through T_4 are all units. Pan–Sun Theorem 1.1, equation (1.4), supplies v_5(T_(5n)-T_n)≥2+2v_5(n) for n>0; consecutive dilations of 2 therefore converge to U_2≡3 mod 25. For r≥k-1, repeatedly lifting the coefficientwise Frobenius congruence modulo five gives F(x)^(5^r b)≡F(x^(5^(r-k+1)))^(5^(k-1)b) mod 5^k. With 5^(r-k+1)>a the only exponent cancellation against F(x)^a is zero with zero, including when a=0 or b=0. Iterated separated blocks realize all positive powers of U_2. Its reduction has order four modulo five and U_2^4-1 has valuation one, so binomial lifting gives order 4·5^(k-1) for every k≥1. The last block may move arbitrarily far, proving infinite attainment and the exact closure. The frozen script was inspected, not run. Independent path /workspace/branches/5b3b05ae-bf2b-42e5-b554-d67ca95f0173/replay_record5.py verified separated products and dilations at n=52 modulo 25 and n=252 modulo 125; only the proof establishes all moduli.

evidence: Kohen §5 replaces P by a stable Laurent polynomial Ptilde with ct[Ptilde^n]≡ct[P^(p^(k-1)n)] mod p^k. The recurrence gamma(d)V(n)=V(pn+d) and the reset gamma(0)^s=e_(C,C) are valid modulo p^k. Proposition 32 explicitly uses the resulting scalar copy ct[Ptilde^n]·V(0) in the reachable states. Straub's Partial Lucas-type congruences Theorem 1.2 gives a digit law modulo p; the single-state equivalence in Henningsen–Straub Proposition 1.3 is also modulo p. General automaticity in Straub's congruence-schemes paper Theorem 1.1 does not select which outputs occur.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Generic recurrence alone never proves surjectivity. The published reset and digit transitions are stronger evidence: they turn any single reachable constant scalar of the stabilized sequence into a repeatable multiplicative factor. This suffices in the assigned case because that scalar already generates the full unit group.

value.rationale: The exact image of this natural sequence is a meaningful mathematical question, and the submitted direct proof is correct. But as a distinct new finding it adds no substantive result to the prior prime-power reset method: the scalar selection uses the known dilation of T_2 and its elementary multiplicative order, and the same reachable-word computation provides infinite witnesses. No additional statistic, quantitative improvement or new structural case survives the implication. This is not a judgment against the inherent interest of the question.
